subject: math
question: 计算积分 $\int \frac{7\sin x + \cos x}{3\sin x + 4\cos x}\mathrm{d}x.$
answer: $$ I = \int \mathrm{d} x - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (3 \sin x + 4 \cos x)}{3 \sin x + 4 \cos x} = x - \ln | 3 \sin x + 4 \cos x | + C. $$

steps.text: 分析 当被积函数是正弦、余弦的线性齐次分式函数时，可将分子拆分为分母及其导数的常数倍，再分项积分；也可以用“组合积分法”来计算.

方法1 因为 $7\sin x + \cos x = (3\sin x + 4\cos x) - (3\sin x + 4\cos x)^{\prime}$ ，所以

$$
I = \int \mathrm{d} x - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (3 \sin x + 4 \cos x)}{3 \sin x + 4 \cos x} = x - \ln | 3 \sin x + 4 \cos x | + C.
$$

方法2 记 $I_{1} = \int \frac{\sin x}{3\sin x + 4\cos x}\mathrm{d}x$ ， $I_{2} = \int \frac{\cos x}{3\sin x + 4\cos x}\mathrm{d}x$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} 3 I _ {1} + 4 I _ {2} & = \int \mathrm{d} x = x + C _ {1}, \\ - 4 I _ {1} + 3 I _ {2} & = \int \frac {- 4 \sin x + 3 \cos x}{3 \sin x + 4 \cos x} \mathrm{d} x = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (3 \sin x + 4 \cos x)}{3 \sin x + 4 \cos x} \\ & = \ln | 3 \sin x + 4 \cos x | + C _ {2}. \end{array}\tag{①}
$$

②

①-②式得

$$
I = 7 I _ {1} + I _ {2} = x - \ln | 3 \sin x + 4 \cos x | + C.
$$

solution.final_answer: $$ I = \int \mathrm{d} x - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (3 \sin x + 4 \cos x)}{3 \sin x + 4 \cos x} = x - \ln | 3 \sin x + 4 \cos x | + C. $$

meta.commentary:
评注 若被积函数为 $\frac{a\sin x + b\cos x}{c\sin x + d\cos x}$ ，则可令

$$
a \sin x + b \cos x = A (c \sin x + d \cos x) + B (c \sin x + d \cos x) ^ {\prime},
$$

解出 A, B 得到拆分式，再积分.
